topics.label: IaaS, PaaS & SaaS
topics.desc: The canonical service-model taxonomy defining where the provider/customer responsibility boundary sits across the compute-to-application stack.

topics.label: Shared Responsibility Model
topics.desc: Provider-vs-customer security and operations split that varies by service model and dictates what you must secure yourself.

topics.label: Public, Private & Hybrid
topics.desc: Public, private, hybrid, and community deployment topologies trading control, isolation, and compliance against elasticity and cost.

topics.label: Multi-Cloud Strategy
topics.desc: Running across multiple providers to avoid lock-in or meet sovereignty needs, paying in portability and operational complexity.

topics.label: Regions & Availability Zones
topics.desc: Geographic regions and isolated availability zones that bound latency, data residency, and the blast radius of correlated failures.

topics.label: Cloud-Native Principles
topics.desc: Designing for elasticity, managed services, and disposability so apps exploit the cloud rather than merely run on it.

topics.label: Well-Architected Framework
topics.desc: Provider pillar frameworks (reliability, security, cost, performance, operations) used to review and harden cloud architectures.

topics.label: Virtual Machines
topics.desc: Hypervisor-backed instances giving full OS control; the baseline IaaS compute unit sized by vCPU, memory, and instance family.

topics.label: Instance Families & Sizing
topics.desc: Compute-, memory-, GPU-, and storage-optimized instance classes matched to workload profiles to balance performance and price.

topics.label: Autoscaling
topics.desc: Policy- or metric-driven horizontal scaling of instance pools to track demand while controlling cost and headroom.

topics.label: Spot & Preemptible
topics.desc: Deeply discounted reclaimable capacity ideal for fault-tolerant, interruptible workloads accepting eviction on short notice.

topics.label: Managed Kubernetes
topics.desc: Provider-operated control planes (EKS/GKE/AKS) offering container orchestration without managing masters or etcd yourself.

topics.label: Managed Container Services
topics.desc: Serverless container platforms (Fargate, Cloud Run) running images without provisioning or patching the underlying hosts.

topics.label: GPU & Accelerated Compute
topics.desc: On-demand GPU/TPU/accelerator instances for training, inference, and HPC where parallel throughput dominates cost decisions.

topics.label: Object Storage
topics.desc: Flat HTTP-addressable key/value blob stores (S3, GCS) offering near-infinite, durable, cheap capacity for unstructured data.

topics.label: Block Storage
topics.desc: Network-attached virtual disks providing low-latency, mountable volumes with provisioned IOPS for databases and boot disks.

topics.label: Managed File Storage
topics.desc: Shared POSIX/NFS/SMB filesystems offering concurrent multi-host mounts for lift-and-shift and shared-state workloads.

topics.label: Storage Tiers & Lifecycle
topics.desc: Hot/cool/archive tiers and lifecycle rules that automatically migrate or expire objects to cut cost as data ages.

topics.label: Durability & Replication
topics.desc: Eleven-nines durability via erasure coding and cross-AZ/region replication, distinct from availability and backup guarantees.

topics.label: Managed Databases
topics.desc: Provider-run relational, NoSQL, and serverless DBs handling patching, backups, failover, and replicas as a service.

topics.label: Content Delivery Networks
topics.desc: Globally distributed edge caches that serve static and dynamic content close to users, cutting latency and origin load.

topics.label: Virtual Private Cloud
topics.desc: Logically isolated software-defined network with private CIDR ranges, the foundation for segmenting and securing cloud resources.

topics.label: Subnets & Routing
topics.desc: Public/private subnet partitioning with route tables, NAT, and gateways controlling internal and egress traffic paths.

topics.label: Security Groups & NACLs
topics.desc: Stateful instance firewalls and stateless subnet ACLs that form the primary in-cloud network access-control layer.

topics.label: Cloud Load Balancers
topics.desc: Managed L4/L7 load balancers distributing traffic across healthy targets with TLS termination and path-based routing.

topics.label: Managed DNS
topics.desc: Authoritative DNS services with health checks and latency/geo/weighted routing policies for failover and traffic steering.

topics.label: Private & Hybrid Connectivity
topics.desc: VPC peering, private endpoints, VPN, and dedicated interconnects linking VPCs and on-prem without traversing the public internet.

topics.label: API Gateway
topics.desc: Managed front door handling routing, authn, rate limiting, and request transformation for APIs and serverless backends.

topics.label: Service Mesh
topics.desc: Sidecar-based layer adding mTLS, traffic shaping, and telemetry to service-to-service calls without app code changes.

topics.label: Functions as a Service
topics.desc: Event-triggered, stateless functions billed per invocation that auto-scale to zero, abstracting away all server management.

topics.label: Cold Starts
topics.desc: Latency penalty when a function runtime is initialized from idle, mitigated via provisioned concurrency or lightweight runtimes.

topics.label: Event-Driven Architecture
topics.desc: Loosely coupled systems where components react to events via buses and topics, enabling independent scaling and evolution.

topics.label: Managed Queues & Streams
topics.desc: Hosted queues, pub/sub, and streaming (SQS, Kafka, Kinesis) that buffer and fan out events to decouple producers from consumers.

topics.label: Workflow Orchestration
topics.desc: State-machine services (Step Functions, Workflows) coordinating multi-step serverless flows with retries and error handling.

topics.label: Edge Computing
topics.desc: Running functions at CDN PoPs near users for ultra-low latency, personalization, and offloading work from central regions.

topics.label: Backend as a Service
topics.desc: Turnkey backends (auth, database, storage) like Firebase/Supabase letting clients integrate features without server code.

topics.label: SLIs, SLOs & SLAs
topics.desc: Quantified reliability targets where indicators feed objectives that drive engineering and back contractual agreements.

topics.label: Error Budgets
topics.desc: The allowable unreliability implied by an SLO, spent to balance release velocity against stability and gate launches.

topics.label: Toil & Automation
topics.desc: Eliminating repetitive manual operational work through automation so engineering effort scales sublinearly with the system.

topics.label: Observability Pillars
topics.desc: Metrics, logs, and traces combined to let operators ask arbitrary questions about a system's internal state from outside.

topics.label: On-Call & Incident Response
topics.desc: Sustainable rotations, escalation, and structured incident command for detecting, mitigating, and resolving outages.

topics.label: Blameless Postmortems
topics.desc: Blameless retrospectives that turn incidents into systemic fixes and durable learning rather than individual blame.

topics.label: Capacity Planning
topics.desc: Forecasting demand and provisioning headroom from load tests and growth trends to meet SLOs without over-spending.

topics.label: Redundancy & Failover
topics.desc: Eliminating single points of failure via redundant components and automated failover to standby capacity on detection.

topics.label: High Availability
topics.desc: Architecting multi-AZ/multi-region topologies to meet availability targets despite component, zone, or region failures.

topics.label: Disaster Recovery
topics.desc: RTO/RPO-driven strategies (backup, pilot light, warm standby, active-active) for recovering from catastrophic loss.

topics.label: Fault Isolation & Bulkheads
topics.desc: Partitioning resources into cells and bulkheads so a failure or overload in one is contained from the rest of the system.

topics.label: Graceful Degradation
topics.desc: Shedding load and serving reduced functionality under stress so core paths survive instead of cascading to total failure.

topics.label: Chaos Engineering
topics.desc: Deliberately injecting failures in production-like systems to validate resilience assumptions before real outages expose them.

topics.label: Backup & Restore
topics.desc: Tested, versioned, geographically separated backups whose restore drills prove recoverability against data loss and ransomware.

topics.label: Cloud Pricing Models
topics.desc: On-demand, reserved, savings-plan, and spot pricing whose tradeoffs of commitment versus flexibility drive total spend.

topics.label: FinOps
topics.desc: Cross-team practice giving engineering financial accountability for cloud spend through visibility, allocation, and optimization.

topics.label: Cost Optimization
topics.desc: Rightsizing, autoscaling, commitments, tiering, and egress reduction to cut waste while preserving performance and reliability.

topics.label: Tagging & Cost Allocation
topics.desc: Resource tagging and showback/chargeback that attribute spend to teams, products, and environments for accountability.

topics.label: Cloud Governance
topics.desc: Org-wide accounts, guardrails, service-control policies, and landing zones enforcing standards across many cloud teams.

topics.label: Cloud IAM
topics.desc: Identity and access management with least-privilege roles, policies, and federation governing who can touch which resources.

topics.label: Compliance & Data Residency
topics.desc: Meeting SOC2/HIPAA/GDPR and residency mandates via controls, audit evidence, and region-pinned data placement.
